+++ b/packages/query-core/src/persister.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+import type { DefaultError } from './types'
+import type { QueryState } from './query'
+
+const persisterRestoreResultSymbol = Symbol('persisterRestoreResult')
+
+export interface PersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+> {
+  data?: TData
+  state: QueryState<TData, TError>
+  isPersisterRestoreResult: true
+  [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]: true
+}
+
+export function createPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(params: {
+  data?: TData
+  state: QueryState<TData, TError>
+}): PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  return {
+    data: params.data !== undefined ? params.data : params.state?.data,
+    state: params.state,
+    isPersisterRestoreResult: true,
+    [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]: true,
+  }
+}
+
+export function isPersisterRestoreResult(
+  result: unknown,
+): result is PersisterRestoreResult<any, any> {
+  return (
+    result != null &&
+    typeof result === 'object' &&
+    (persisterRestoreResultSymbol in result ||
+      (result as any).isPersisterRestoreResult === true)
+  )
+}
+
+export function reconcileQueryState<TData = unknown, TError = DefaultError>(
+  liveState: QueryState<TData, TError> | undefined,
+  persistedState: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+): QueryState<TData, TError> {
+  if (!liveState) {
+    return {
+      ...persistedState,
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+  }
+
+  const liveDataUpdatedAt = liveState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0
+  const persistedDataUpdatedAt = persistedState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0
+
+  const usePersistedData = persistedDataUpdatedAt >= liveDataUpdatedAt
+
+  const data = usePersistedData ? persistedState.data : liveState.data
+  const dataUpdatedAt = usePersistedData
+    ? persistedDataUpdatedAt
+    : liveDataUpdatedAt
+  const dataUpdateCount = usePersistedData
+    ? persistedState.dataUpdateCount
+    : liveState.dataUpdateCount
+
+  const liveErrorUpdatedAt = liveState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0
+  const persistedErrorUpdatedAt = persistedState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0
+
+  const usePersistedError = persistedErrorUpdatedAt >= liveErrorUpdatedAt
+
+  const error = usePersistedError ? persistedState.error : liveState.error
+  const errorUpdatedAt = usePersistedError
+    ? persistedErrorUpdatedAt
+    : liveErrorUpdatedAt
+  const errorUpdateCount = usePersistedError
+    ? persistedState.errorUpdateCount
+    : liveState.errorUpdateCount
+  const fetchFailureCount = usePersistedError
+    ? persistedState.fetchFailureCount
+    : liveState.fetchFailureCount
+  const fetchFailureReason = usePersistedError
+    ? persistedState.fetchFailureReason
+    : liveState.fetchFailureReason
+
+  const isInvalidated = liveState.isInvalidated || persistedState.isInvalidated
+
+  let status: 'pending' | 'success' | 'error'
+  if (error !== null) {
+    status = 'error'
+  } else if (data !== undefined) {
+    status = 'success'
+  } else {
+    status = 'pending'
+  }
+
+  return {
+    data,
+    dataUpdateCount,
+    dataUpdatedAt,
+    error,
+    errorUpdateCount,
+    errorUpdatedAt,
+    fetchFailureCount,
+    fetchFailureReason,
+    fetchMeta: usePersistedError
+      ? persistedState.fetchMeta
+      : liveState.fetchMeta,
+    fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    isInvalidated,
+    status,
+  }
+}
